# Exercise 1

Using pandas and `flights.parquet`:

1. How many flights to LAX did each legacy carrier (AA, UA, DL, US) have in May from JFK, and what was their mean actual air time?
2. Which plane has the most flight records from each New York airport (no missing tail numbers, all ties)?
3. Which five calendar dates had the lowest mean departure delay (ties broken by earliest date)?
4. Which flight has the largest arrival delay as a percentage of its actual air time (no missing values or nonpositive air times, all ties)?

```{python}
flights = pd.read_parquet("../data/flights.parquet")
```

```{python}
(flights
  .query("dest == 'LAX' and origin == 'JFK' and month == 5 and carrier in ['AA', 'UA', 'DL', 'US']")
  .groupby("carrier", as_index=False)
  .agg(
    n = ("flight", "size"),
    avg_air_time = ("air_time", "mean")
  )
)
```

```{python}
n = (flights
  .dropna(subset=["tailnum"])
  .groupby(["origin", "tailnum"], as_index=False)
  .size()
)
n[n["size"] == n.groupby("origin")["size"].transform("max")]
```

```{python}
(flights
  .groupby(["year", "month", "day"], as_index=False)
  .agg(avg_dep_delay = ("dep_delay", "mean"))
  .dropna(subset=["avg_dep_delay"])
  .sort_values(["avg_dep_delay", "year", "month", "day"])
  .head(5)
)
```

```{python}
pct = (flights
  .dropna(subset=["arr_delay"])
  .query("air_time > 0")
  .assign(arr_delay_pct = 100 * pd.col("arr_delay") / pd.col("air_time"))
)
(pct
  [pct["arr_delay_pct"] == pct["arr_delay_pct"].max()]
  [["month", "day", "carrier", "flight", "origin", "dest", "arr_delay", "air_time", "arr_delay_pct"]]
)
```


# Exercise 2

Using polars: repeat questions 1 to 4 from Exercise 1, then (5) rewrite question 1 to start from `pl.scan_parquet()` and look at `explain()` before collecting.

```{python}
flights = pl.read_parquet("../data/flights.parquet")
legacy = ["AA", "UA", "DL", "US"]
```

```{python}
flights.filter(
  pl.col("dest") == "LAX",
  pl.col("origin") == "JFK",
  pl.col("month") == 5,
  pl.col("carrier").is_in(legacy)
).group_by("carrier").agg(
  n = pl.len(),
  avg_air_time = pl.col("air_time").mean()
).sort("carrier")
```

```{python}
(flights
  .drop_nulls("tailnum")
  .group_by("origin", "tailnum")
  .len()
  .filter(pl.col("len") == pl.col("len").max().over("origin"))
  .sort("origin")
)
```

```{python}
(flights
  .group_by("year", "month", "day")
  .agg(avg_dep_delay = pl.col("dep_delay").mean())
  .drop_nulls("avg_dep_delay")
  .sort("avg_dep_delay", "year", "month", "day")
  .head(5)
)
```

```{python}
(flights
  .filter(pl.col("arr_delay").is_not_null(), pl.col("air_time") > 0)
  .with_columns(arr_delay_pct = 100 * pl.col("arr_delay") / pl.col("air_time"))
  .filter(pl.col("arr_delay_pct") == pl.col("arr_delay_pct").max())
  .select("month", "day", "carrier", "flight", "origin", "dest", "arr_delay", "air_time", "arr_delay_pct")
)
```

```{python}
q = (
  pl.scan_parquet("../data/flights.parquet")
  .filter(
    pl.col("dest") == "LAX",
    pl.col("origin") == "JFK",
    pl.col("month") == 5,
    pl.col("carrier").is_in(legacy)
  )
  .group_by("carrier")
  .agg(
    n = pl.len(),
    avg_air_time = pl.col("air_time").mean()
  )
  .sort("carrier")
)
print( q.explain() )  # PROJECT 5/19 COLUMNS
q.collect()
```
